_comment: Fixable HIGH/CRITICAL base image findings container-scan tolerates, enforced by check_trivy_exceptions.py. Each entry is one CVE on named packages in one base image digest, until its expiry date (inclusive). Any other finding, another digest or a past expiry fails the job. Add an entry only with a security-review decision on the task; remove it when the base is re-pinned.
